content.title: When is 'American Idol' on tonight? How to watch the 2026 Top 20
content.text: March 16, 2026, 12:01 p.m. MT“American Idol” is moving fast in 2026.After culling the herd from 127 “Idol” hopefuls to a lean Top 30 in just two installments of Hollywood Week in Music City, also bill as Music City Takeover, the episode that aired on Monday, March 2, sent another 10 contestants packing, giving us the Season 24 Top 20.Three of those contestants earned platinum tickets, one chosen by industry executives, one by the contestants' families, which seems weird, and by the contestants, also weird.And just like that, it’s time to vote.You can’t use the “American Idol” app, though. That’s been discontinued. You can still vote through the website, though, at https://www.americanidol.com, or via text.Here’s everything you need to know about the latest episode of “American Idol.”Top 20 'American Idol' for 2026These are the singers who made the "American Idol" Top 30 for 2026:Jordan McCullough (platinum ticket)Brooks Rosser (platinum ticket)Kyndal Inskeep (platinum ticket)Ruby RaeMadison MoonPhilmon LeeBraden RumfeltJake ThistleJesse FindlingGenevieve HeywardLucas LeonHannah HarperChris TungsethJulián KalelRaeDaniel StallworthAbayomiKutter BradleyMakiyahKeyla Richardson.Did Kelly Clarkson actually win "American Idol"?Depends on who you ask. She definitely won the competition, launching the most successful post-reality career in "Idol" history.But here's what Clarkson told Rob Rausch, who won "The Traitors" Season 4 and said he never got the $220,800 he was promised as the winner, on "The Kelly Clarkson Show."“I relate to this so hardcore because whenever I won, you probably weren’t alive when I was on ‘American Idol,’ but I literally was on the show, and they were like, ‘Oh, you win a million dollars or whatever.’ No, you didn’t. They lied."The singer said she also never got the car she was supposed to get for winning.This newsletter goes to 11. Sign up for weekly music news. Where are 'American Idol' contestants competing tonight?The "American Idol" Top 20 contestants will compete at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawaii for the next two episodes.2026 judges for 'American Idol'The judges for Season 24 of "American Idol" are Lionel Richie, Luke Bryan and Carrie Underwood, who joined the cast in 2025 when Katy Perry signed off after seven seasons.Before signing on as a judge, Underwood won Season 4 and went on to enjoy one of the most successful post-“Idol” careers of any former winner — right up there with Kelly Clarkson.Is 'American Idol' on tonight?Yes. "American Idol" will air its fourth audition round of 2026 on Monday, March 16.When is 'American Idol' on tonight?"American Idol" airs at 8 p.m. ET and 7 p.m. Arizona time.How to watch 'American Idol' tonightYou can watch "American Idol" live on ABC15 in Arizona or on your local ABC network.'American Idol' time"American Idol" airs at 8 p.m. ET and 7 p.m. Arizona time.Where to watch 'American Idol' in 2026?In addition to airing in Arizona on ABC15, "American Idol" Season 24 will be available to stream the following day on Hulu.A subscription to Hulu costs $11.99 a month (or $119.99/year) for the ad-supported plan. Students can get Hulu with ads for $1.99 a month, and Hulu Premium, with no ads, is $18.99 a month.'American Idol' winnersTrying to remember who won "American Idol" the year you graduated high school or got out of prison?
